files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  Template gallery: a heading, outline filter pills, a grid of template cards and a full-width browse-all
  button.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Template, Filter, TemplateLabels } from "./template-grid.types";

  export type TemplateGridProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    templates: Template[];
    filters: Filter[];
    browseHref?: string;
    labels: TemplateLabels;
    cols?: "1-3" | "1-4";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    density?: "roomy" | "default" | "compact";
    empty?: string;
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../compose/Box.svelte";
  import Button from "../compose/Button.svelte";
  import Grid from "../compose/Grid.svelte";
  import Group from "../compose/Group.svelte";
  import IconBadge from "../compose/IconBadge.svelte";
  import Inline from "../compose/Inline.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import Title from "../compose/Title.svelte";
  import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { defaults } from "../presets/defaults";
  import { cn, urlOf } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    templates,
    filters,
    browseHref,
    labels,
    cols = "1-4",
    tone = "default",
    density = "compact",
    empty = "",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: TemplateGridProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} tone={tone} density={density} measure="fill" class="py-0" landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}>
  <Stack gap="8" align="stretch">
    <Group gap="4" align="center" justify="between" class="h-8 w-full flex-wrap">
      <Title as={2} size="2xl" weight="semibold" class="leading-9" id={(id + "-title")}>
        {title}
      </Title>
      {#if ((filters?.length ?? 0) > 0)}
        <Group
          gap="4"
          align="center"
          class="flex-wrap"
          role="group"
          aria-label={labels.filters}
          data-testid="template-filters"
        >
          {#each filters as f (f.id)}
            <Button variant="outline" size="sm" type="button" class="gap-2" data-testid="template-filter">
              {#if f.icon}
                <LucideIcon name={f.icon} size={16} />
              {/if}
              {f.title}
            </Button>
          {/each}
        </Group>
      {/if}
    </Group>
    {#if ((templates?.length ?? 0) === 0)}
      <EmptyState icon="layout-template" title={empty} />
    {:else}
      <Grid cols={cols} class="w-full gap-6" data-testid="template-grid">
        {#each templates as t (t.id)}
          <Box
            class={cn(
              "flex flex-col gap-2 overflow-hidden rounded p-4 inset-ring inset-ring-border",
              defaults.templates.card
            )}
            data-testid="template-card"
          >
            <Box class={cn("shrink-0 overflow-hidden", defaults.templates.image)}>
              <MediaFrame alt={t.title} class={cn("size-full", defaults.media.rounded)} />
            </Box>
            <Group gap="4" align="center" class={cn("w-full", defaults.templates.footer)} data-testid="template-footer">
              <IconBadge size="sm" class="overflow-hidden" data-testid="template-avatar">
                <LucideIcon name="layout-template" size={16} />
              </IconBadge>
              <Stack gap="0" class="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <Title as={3} size="base" weight="semibold" class="truncate leading-6">
                  {t.title}
                </Title>
                <Group gap="4" align="center" class="h-4 text-muted-foreground">
                  <Group gap="2" align="center">
                    <LucideIcon name="eye" size={16} />
                    <Inline class="sr-only">
                      {labels.views}
                    </Inline>
                    <Text size="xs" weight="bold" class="leading-4">
                      {t.views}
                    </Text>
                  </Group>
                  <Group gap="2" align="center">
                    <LucideIcon name="heart" size={16} />
                    <Inline class="sr-only">
                      {labels.likes}
                    </Inline>
                    <Text size="xs" weight="bold" class="leading-4">
                      {t.likes}
                    </Text>
                  </Group>
                </Group>
              </Stack>
            </Group>
          </Box>
        {/each}
      </Grid>
    {/if}
    <Button variant="outline" size="sm" href={urlOf(browseHref)} class="w-full" data-testid="template-browse">
      {labels.browse}
    </Button>
  </Stack>
</SectionFrame>
